name: Diagramly Desktop
subtitle: Mermaid & ZenUML diagrams
promotionalText: Edit ZenUML and Mermaid diagrams on your Mac. Write source, see a live preview, and connect an MCP client you provide.
description:
Diagramly Desktop is a local editor for ZenUML and Mermaid diagrams on your Mac.

EDIT WITH A LIVE PREVIEW
Write or change diagram source and see the rendered result update. Open a diagram from your board in its own editor with a double-click.

ORGANIZE WITH PAGES
Keep related views in Pages tabs within a diagram.

BRING YOUR ZENUML LIBRARY
Import a library exported as JSON by the older ZenUML desktop app, then continue working with its diagrams and pages.

CONNECT YOUR MCP CLIENT
Connect an MCP client that you provide and configure to work with your local diagram. You are responsible for the client and any AI provider account or charges it requires.

This proposed update continues the existing paid ZenUML Mac app listing as Diagramly Desktop. It does not add Diagramly cloud AI, a subscription, or in-app purchases. Confirm all features and wording against the signed release build before submission.
